title: Piper RV Park

services.name: monthly RV site
services.desc: A monthly RV site rental is not simply a longer campground stay. It is the place where you park your home, manage your routines, greet your neighbors, and settle into a community for 30 days or more. That changes what matters. A convenient location and a fair monthly rate are a good start, but the best fit also supports the ordinary parts of life: workdays, grocery runs, pet walks, mail, quiet evenings, and easy access to the places you need to go. For RV and tiny-home owners looking for a residential base, taking a few extra minutes to compare sites can prevent frustration later. The goal is not to find the most vacation-style amenities. It is to find a clean, practical place that works

blurb: Located at 8510 NE Hwy 99 in the 98665 area, our park was built in 1956 conveniently located right off I-5. There are plenty of stores and restaurants within walking distance. We welcome recreational vehicles originally manufactured for living purposes. Rent is starting at $860.
